---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a new capability, agent, adapter, or improvement
labels: enhancement
---

## Problem / motivation

What problem does this solve, or what capability is missing?

## Proposed solution

Describe the behavior you want. For agent/adapter/tool changes, mention which
capability in the registry this maps to (e.g. reconnaissance, analysis).

## Alternatives considered

Any alternative approaches you have thought about.

## Security considerations

Does this touch target authorization, policy enforcement, sandboxing, or
evidence handling? If yes, describe how safety guarantees are preserved.
